item.title: Dr. Robot: Premier Health demos new 'state-of-the-art' technology
item.description: As quickly as technology is progressing, your doctor may be a robot. Premiere Health recently demonstrated new technology, Intuitive's da Vinci 5, at Miami Valley Hospital South. item.title: Germantown's historic bridge set for $1M restoration project
item.description: Previous Germantown coverage above. DAYTON, Ohio (WDTN) – Germantown’s Historic Covered Bridge will have a $1 million rehabilitation construction project starting on Monday, March 23. The project will address structural concerns and improve the longevity of the regional landmark. Once the project is finished the bridge to be placed back on the National Historic Register. [...]
